_comment: issueLabelToSkill: User-defined mapping of a Linear issue label (key, format: agent-*) to the Claude /skill it invokes (value). Each skill must exist in the repo's .claude/settings.json. Teams can define any labels they want based on their available skills. policy.skipDoneIssues: when true, updates on issues whose Linear state is Completed/Canceled never dispatch, even if a trigger label was added. policy.duplicateRunWindowMs: minimum time between two runs for the same (issue, domain, skill) before a new one is rejected as a duplicate.
